# Laurelwood Estates

> Laurelwood Estates is the hyperlocal guide to the Laurelwood neighborhood and the Dona streets of Studio City, California, presented by Misraje Real Estate Partners. Jack Misraje and Karen Misraje are the real estate agents serving West Laurelwood, East Laurelwood, and the Dona streets.
